info.name: Chat Archive
info.summary: Read and search your WhatsApp chats inside Nextcloud
info.description:
Chat Archive turns the WhatsApp backup of your phone into a private, searchable archive on your own Nextcloud: every chat, every message and every call, with the photos, videos, voice notes and documents that came with them.
**How it works**
WhatsApp writes an end-to-end encrypted backup on your phone. The Nextcloud mobile app uploads that backup and the media files to a folder in your Nextcloud. You give Chat Archive the folder and the 64-digit key of the backup. From then on it imports each new backup by itself. Nothing leaves your server.
**What you get**
- **Your chats, as you know them**: private chats and groups with messages, captions, calls and media, newest first. - **Search across all chats** at one time, with filters for the chat, the sender, the type and the date. Find that address, invoice or photo from three years ago. - **Every photo, document or link in one list**, from all chats. - **The call history**, with duration and result. - **Names, not numbers**: contact names come from your Nextcloud address books. - **Files you can move**: the archive points at each file by its Nextcloud file id. Move or rename a file anywhere in your storage, and the chat still opens it. - **A record of what changed**: a message that was deleted or edited on the phone stays in the archive, with a mark. - **Nextcloud search**: the search box of Nextcloud finds your messages too. The Full text search app is optional and gives ranked results. - **WhatsApp and WhatsApp Business** side by side, each as its own source.
**What it is not**
Chat Archive is not a WhatsApp client. It does not send messages. An administrator can allow an optional, read-only live sync through a WAHA server, which brings in new messages between two backups. Live sync uses an unofficial connection to WhatsApp and has a risk for your number: read the user guide first.
**Requirements**
A working Nextcloud background job (cron). On the phone: WhatsApp with end-to-end encrypted backup and a 64-digit key, and the Nextcloud mobile app with auto upload.
The [user guide](https://github.com/amsys/chat_archive/blob/main/docs/USER-GUIDE.md) gives each step. This is a beta release.
